item.title: Photos show Día de Muertos celebration at Seattle’s Pike Place Market
item.description: SEATTLE, Washington (AP) — Seattle’s Pike Place Market celebrated Day of the Dead, or Día de Muertos, for the first time Friday, with mariachi and folklórico performances, lucha libre wrestling and ofrendas honoring deceased loved ones and Mexican heritage.

item.title: Japan's unpopular revision of Imperial law that reinforces male-only succession takes effect
